rationale: Matches the codebase's existing independent-flag idiom (--background/--serve/--queue on the same subparser); zero shared teardown state with the existing --serve bridge, which closes fully inside run.py's own try/finally before any post-run hook could fire.
rule: Option SERVE-A: distinct --serve-after flag/hook for post-completion serving
alternatives_rejected: Option SERVE-B (overload existing --serve to survive past terminal state): contradicts --serve's own documented byte-identical-without-it contract, no precedent for per-loop conditional flag reinterpretation, no existing test coverage of the behavior it would change.
